Andronikos II’s first wife (often called Agnes/Anna of Hungary, b. c. 1260) was the daughter of Stephen V and Elizabeth the Cuman—not of Béla IV and Maria Laskarina (who was the mother of a different Anna, Duchess of Macsó).
